items.titleZh: 劳森分享复古视频，十年后首次现场演出
items.summaryZh: 劳森不仅在奥斯汀驾驶小红牛赛车参赛，还在周四进行了他十年来的首次现场音乐演出。演出前，他发布了一段与兄弟和童年朋友的复古视频。

items.originalTitle: Liam Lawson shares throwback video before first live performance in over a decade
detailZh: 劳森在首次超过十年的现场表演前分享了怀旧视频
小红牛车手劳森与他的兄弟和童年朋友们重聚，为他首次现场音乐表演助阵
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
劳森不仅仅是在奥斯汀驾驶小红牛赛车来参加比赛，你知道吗？在周四，他还进行了十多年来的首次现场音乐表演。在演出前，他发布了一段自己与兄弟和童年朋友们一起演奏的怀旧视频。
这篇帖子在撰写时已经获得了87,000个赞和超过370条评论，粉丝们兴奋地期待着在美洲赛车场的比赛周末看到这位新西兰车手。
劳森在周四晚上美国大奖赛之前来到了Esses Bazaar的舞台，与他的兄弟马库斯和童年好友托马斯和哈里森重逢。这是他自11岁以来第一次在人群中表演。
“我11岁时曾在人群中表演，那也是我最后一次这样做。已经很久了，”他在表演前对《人物》杂志说。
劳森和他的兄弟在父亲引导下一起在新西兰长大，一起弹奏音乐。
“音乐一直伴随着我的生活和家人的生活，自从我非常小的时候起，”劳森继续说道。 “他让我和我的兄弟从小就接触吉他。我们基本上是一起长大的。”
他补充说，他为了吉他考试学习了七年，甚至在孩提时代就写了自己的歌曲。尽管如此，他现在并没有打算开始写歌。
“和我的兄弟还有我从小一起玩的朋友们一起做这件事是个很酷的机会，”劳森对媒体说。 “说实话，我们大概有十年没做过这样的事情了。”
这次表演吸引了许多一级方程式明星，丹尼尔·里卡多、伊萨克·哈贾尔和阿维德·林德布拉德都出现在东第六街的Inn Cahoots。”
劳森在定制的泰勒吉他上演奏了一首乡村风格的经典曲目。
小红牛后来称这是一场“充满音乐和朋友的难忘之夜”。
劳森在即将到来的美洲赛车场的比赛中，以75分位列车手锦标赛第九位。
detailEn: Liam Lawson shares throwback video before first live performance in over a decade
Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson reunited with his brother and childhood friends for his first live music performance
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Liam Lawson isn't just in Austin to race behind the wheel of a Racing Bulls car, you know? On Thursday, he also played his first live music gig in over a decade. Before the show, he posted a throwback clip of himself playing beside his brother and childhood friends.
The post had passed 87,000 likes and more than 370 comments at the time of writing, with fans excited to see the Kiwi over the race weekend at Circuit of the Americas.

Lawson took to the stage at the Esses Bazaar on Thursday night ahead of the United States Grand Prix, reuniting with his brother Marcus and childhood friends Thomas and Harrison. It was the first time he had played in front of a crowd since he was 11.
“I played in front of a crowd when I was 11, and that was the last time I did it. It’s been a long time,” he told People before the show.
The group grew up playing music together in New Zealand, after Lawson’s father got both of his sons into playing the guitar.
“Music’s been in my life and my family’s life since I was very, very young,” Lawson continued. “He got me and my brother into guitar when we were very young. We grew up basically playing together.”
He added that he had studied for guitar exams for seven years, and even wrote his own songs as a child. He doesn't have plans to start writing now, though.
“It’s a cool opportunity to do this with my brother and a couple of friends that I’ve grown up playing with,” Lawson told the media. “To be honest, we haven’t done this for like 10 years.”
The performance drew a strong turnout of Formula 1 stars, with Daniel Ricciardo, Isack Hadjar and Arvid Lindblad all in the crowd at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street.
Lawson played a mostly country set of covers on a signature Taylor guitar made for him.
Racing Bulls later called it “an unforgettable evening filled with music and friends”.
Lawson is ninth in the drivers’ championship on 75 points heading into this weekend’s race at the Circuit of the Americas.

items.originalTitle: Fans lose it as Daniel Ricciardo spotted supporting Liam Lawson at Austin live performance
detailZh: 粉丝们在奥斯汀现场表演中看到丹尼尔·里卡多支持利亚姆·劳森时情绪失控
小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森在美国大奖赛前夕在奥斯汀登台进行罕见的现场音乐表演
丹尼尔·里卡多，Visa Cash App 小红牛 F1车队
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
利亚姆·劳森在周四晚上在奥斯汀的舞台上看到了一些熟悉的面孔。
这位新西兰人在Esses Bazaar ATX的Garage 各节练习与排位 with 劳森 and Friends上担任主角，这是在美国大奖赛周末之前在东第六街的Inn Cahoots举行的。
劳森在2024年取代了丹尼尔·里卡多在小红牛的位置，里卡多在那里观看，还有他现在的队友阿维德·林德布拉德和前队友伊萨克·哈吉尔也在场。
劳森与他的兄弟马库斯以及两个童年好友托马斯和哈里森一起表演，这是他自11岁以来第一次公开表演。
“我有很多感受。我的意思是，我对……能和我的兄弟还有几个从小一起玩的朋友一起做这件事感到很兴奋，”这位24岁的年轻人告诉在奥斯汀表演前的媒体。
“说实话，我们大概有10年没做过这样的事情了。显然，我们从未真正表演过，但我们很小的时候就一起长大了。所以这是一个很酷的机会。但当然，我紧张得要命。”
当被问及现场表演的压力是否比大奖赛更大时，劳森补充说：“哦我的天，比这多10倍的压力。我宁愿坐进一辆一级方程式赛车去Q3，也不愿做这件事。”
小红牛在社交媒体上分享了劳森和里卡多在活动中的照片，以及表演的几个视频。一位粉丝评论道：“小红牛给了人们他们想要的东西，”另一位补充说：“澳大利亚和新西兰喜欢看到这一切。”
“哦我的天哪，我对这件事（我100%在尖叫）完全冷静和沉着，”另一位粉丝发布了一条帖子。
美国大奖赛将于10月25日在美洲赛道举行。
detailEn: Fans lose it as Daniel Ricciardo spotted supporting Liam Lawson at Austin live performance
Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson took to the stage for a rare live music performance in Austin ahead of the United States Grand Prix
Daniel Ricciardo, Visa Cash App RB F1 Team
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Liam Lawson had some familiar faces in the crowd as he took to the stage in Austin on Thursday night.
The New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends at part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.
Daniel Ricciardo, who Lawson replaced at Racing Bulls in 2024, was there to watch along with current team-mate Arvid Lindblad and former team-mate Isack Hadjar.
Lawson performed alongside his brother Marcus and two childhood friends, Thomas and Harrison, in what was his first public performance since he was 11.

"I am feeling a lot of things. I mean, I'm excited for... It's a cool opportunity to do this with my brother and a couple of friends that I've grown up playing with," the 24-year-old told the media in Austin ahead of the performance.

"To be honest, we haven't done this for like 10 years. And obviously, we never really performed, but we grew up playing together when we were very young. So it's a cool opportunity. But no, I'm sh***ing myself, for sure."

When asked if there was more pressure for the live performance than for a grand prix, Lawson added: "Oh my God, like 10 times more pressure for this. I would happily get in a Formula 1 car and go into Q3 over doing this."

Racing Bulls shared a photo of Lawson and Ricciardo at the event, along with several videos from the performance. "Racing Bulls giving the people what they want," one fan commented, while another added: "Australasia loves to see it."
"OH MY GOD, I'M TOTALLY CALM AND COLLECTED ABOUT THIS (I’m 110% screaming)," another fan posted.
The United States Grand Prix will take place on 25 October at the Circuit of the Americas.
